selection.reason: This is the only contiguous three-page window with a fully reusable, narratively exact page. It establishes the listener frame, moves to the displaced gods, and ends on the unformed radiance immediately before the page-4 reveal, so it is understandable without prior-book context.

source_evidence.event_008: After Mahiṣa takes Indra's office and divine jurisdictions, the displaced gods led by Brahmā tell Śiva and Viṣṇu their defeat and seek deliverance.
source_evidence.event_009: The gods' separate radiances converge and manifest as a woman, with exact donor-to-body correspondences reserved for the following full-page reveal.

image_audit_scope: Every existing DM04 source illustration from PR6, PR11 and PR12; composed previews and comparison sheets are derived artifacts and are not reclassified as source illustrations.
classification_context: Classification is for reuse in selected pages 1-3. The full_book_remediation field separately records likely future treatment for images outside that sequence.
